raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_customers copies raw_customers.region without decoding it, so 60 customers carry numeric codes '01' to '04' instead of names. raw_region_map supplies a unique one-to-one mapping for exactly those four codes (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so decoding through it restores consistent region names in silver_customers and the gold_region_daily output that joins on it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
